summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K to announce the schedule for its first-quarter 2026 earnings release. The production and sales report will be released on April 30, 2026, followed by financial results on May 11, 2026, with a webcast on May 12, 2026. This is a routine periodic reporting disclosure by the foreign private issuer. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is referenced. The filing contains standard forward-looking statement disclaimers and procedural details. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics to analyze. This is purely an earnings calendar notification, not a special situation.
